channel.title: Building Your Sovereign AI Assistant
channel.itunes:author: Sophie & Mark
channel.description: A 35-part serialized engineering masterclass on designing, coding, and deploying an autonomous personal AI agent from scratch.

item.title: Episode 01: Beyond Chatbots - The Anatomy of an Autonomous Agent
item.description: The difference between passive LLM query-response and autonomous agents. The ReAct loop (Perception, Working Memory, Planning, Action, Reflection). Designing for deterministic execution. Homework: Draft the architectural block diagram of your dream assistant: separate brain, memory, tools, and sensors.
